t: Founded by African American settlers, Liberia became Africa’s first republic on 26 July 1847.
With Ethiopia, it was one of only two African states to escape European colonisation during the partition of Africa.
A settler elite ruled until Samuel Doe’s coup in 1980, which was followed by civil wars from 1989 to 2003.
dyk: Liberia runs one of the world’s largest ship registries: thousands of foreign-owned merchant ships sail under its flag of convenience, a system set up in 1948.
ev: American Colonization Society settlers land at Cape Mesurado, later Monrovia
Liberia declares independence under President Joseph Jenkins Roberts
Firestone receives a vast rubber concession
A forced labour scandal forces President Charles King to resign
William Tubman begins a presidency lasting until 1971
Samuel Doe’s coup ends True Whig Party rule
Charles Taylor’s invasion starts the first Liberian civil war
Ellen Johnson Sirleaf becomes Africa’s first elected female head of state

f.founder: Joseph Jenkins Roberts (first president); American Colonization Society
